description: Unfinished Gordok Business Level 60 Find the Gauntlet of Gordok Might and return it to Captain Kromcrush in Dire Maul. According to Kromcrush, the "old timey story" says that Tortheldrin - a "creepy" elf who called himself a prince - stole it from one of the Gordok kings. Requirements: - Gauntlet of Gordok Might
